title: jams engine game settings, format v2

$schema.description: The game-settings JSON Schema this file follows.

height.description: Virtual px down; the width follows the canvas.

width.description: Virtual px across; the height follows the canvas.

virtual.description: Virtual px the camera shows at zoom 1 on the fixed axis or axes; the game's px per metre maps world metres onto them.

fit.description: expand: the fixed axis fills the canvas and the other shows more; letterbox: the whole virtual area shows, bars fill the rest; crop: the virtual area covers the canvas, the overflow is cut. letterbox and crop need a width and a height.

integer.description: Scale only by whole multiples (pixel art); bars take the remainder.

sampling.description: Default texture sampling; a texture's import filter wins.

pixelSnap.description: Round camera and visual positions to whole canvas pixels.

bars.description: Bar colour, 0xRRGGBB as a number; default the background.

resolution.description: How the world maps onto the canvas; each field given wins over the game's and loses to the host's.

physics.description: The physics world for every scene that doesn't set its own: "rapier" simulates bodies, "none" runs without one. Omitted: the game's.

gravity.description: World gravity [x, y] in m/s² for every scene that doesn't set its own; y is down. Omitted: the game's.

tickRate.description: Ticks per second for every scene, an integer from 1 to 240; the game's time model keeps its kind. Omitted: the game's rate.

game.description: The game's project-wide settings; a project with no game has none.

description: Project-wide settings, at most one file per project. Game code reads `game` with defaults applied.
